about: Published Maros-Meszaros reference objectives shown to be off, by an exact computation (exact_optimum, script) or by independent solvers agreeing on another value (agreed_optimum, comparators). reference.json keeps the published values and every benchmark is still judged against them (matches_reference is unchanged); this file only records what the optimum is, how that was established, and why the published value cannot be met. #980, #1178.

huestis.reason: Diagonal Q, two equality rows, x >= 0: the optimum solved in exact rational arithmetic from the file's decimal strings, every KKT condition checked exactly; the published value is 6.49e-6 above it, more than eight printed digits can explain.

hues-mod.reason: huestis with Q scaled by 1e-4, solved the same way; the published value is 6.49e-6 above the exact optimum, the same error scaled with the model.

liswet8.comparators: HiGHS 714.4700590543218, Clp 714.4700590347206 and PIQP 714.4700559636733, each optimal and the latter two accepted by tools/verify_solution.py, in bench/results/head-to-head-maros-meszaros-d0eb672.csv (#1084); SANKHYA 714.470059768, optimal and verified, with qp_ipm_adaptive_dual_drop (#1178)
liswet8.reason: The published value is ten times the optimum four solvers agree on to eight digits: 7.1447006e+03 against 7.1447006e+02, a misplaced decimal point in the README's OPT column (liswet9 and liswet12, the same family, are met to 1e-8).
